name: feed-shell
title: Feed shell
description: Three columns for community and social apps: navigation on the left, a narrow centre feed with a sticky header, and widgets on the right.
docs: Pass nav (three to five { href, label, icon, badge, badgeLabel } entries; badgeLabel says what the count is about, "new" by default) with currentHref and your router's Link as linkAs, a header (the feed's title) and the posts as children. From md the navigation is a list in the left column with brand, primaryAction and account around it; below md it is a bottom tab bar that clears the home indicator, and primaryAction floats above it (it is rendered once, in the same place in the page). tabs, activeTab and onTabChange come as a set: equal tabs under the title that stay on screen with it, and the posts of the current one go in children. widgets fills the right column from xl and follows the feed below it. The page itself scrolls, not a box inside it, so scroll restoration, find in page and the back button behave as on any page. The shell renders on the server unless you pass tabs; pass mainId when the page already uses id=main.
